Welcome—I'm really glad you're here.
What if you could step into the shoes of a young girl, facing unthinkable challenges, yet somehow finding the strength to keep going?
Together, we're about to explore the world painted so vividly in Alicia: My Story, brought to life by Alicia Appleman-Jurman.
Imagine standing in the heart of World War II, where every day is a fight for survival, and hope feels just out of reach.
In this journey, you’ll witness not just hardship, but moments of kindness and courage that shine through even the darkest times.
As we travel alongside Alicia, we’ll see how small acts of compassion can become powerful acts of resistance—and how the memory of loved ones, even when everything else is lost, can give us the strength to carry on.
We’ll face the uncertainty of occupied Poland, the constant threat of betrayal, and the endless search for safety, all while discovering what it means to hold onto your identity and faith when the world is falling apart.
This isn’t just a story about surviving—it’s about rebuilding, honoring the past, and claiming hope for the future, no matter how impossible it might seem.
So, let’s begin this journey together, and see what we can learn from Alicia’s remarkable spirit.
